content.comment_body: I opened a [product_name] V3.1 project file in [product_name] V4, but the scaling settings for the Analog Threshold Trigger do not save. Each time I reopen the file, the values revert to those from V3.1. Is this a known issue, and will there be an update to resolve it? Thanks,
This problem has been resolved in the current ServicePack ([version_no]). You can use the Update Center to download the latest version.

analysis.insight_summary: The user reports that upgrading a project from [product_name] V3.1 to V4 causes the Analog Threshold Trigger scaling values to revert to previous settings whenever the file is reopened. This issue affects workflow continuity and raises concerns regarding compatibility between legacy and newer software versions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects analog scaling settings to be preserved and correctly loaded when opening older project files in the updated version of the software.
